limitations: All 25 supplied groups are assessed once without changing entity scopes. Images 1–6 correspond to shot1 and 7–12 to shot3, at frames 0,24,48,72,96,120. Registration is untrusted and contains no retained transforms; no global-consensus mapping was used. Local tabletop and window-region tests rely on original support contacts, table boundaries, and the matched radiator wall, not raw coordinate equality. Monocular MAD does not bound systematic error, repeated frames are correlated, and cropped or hidden geometry remains unresolved.
